data.title: Bogdanka Signs Declaration With Enea, Unions And Ministry Of State Assets
data.description:
LW Bogdanka SA :

  • SAID ON THURSDAY THAT ITS MANAGEMENT, ENEA MANAGEMENT, TRADE UNIONS ACTIVE IN BOGDANKA AND LEADERSHIP OF POLAND'S MINISTRY OF STATE ASSETS HAVE SIGNED A DECLARATION

  • UNDER DECLARATION PARTIES AGREED THAT BOGDANKA MANAGEMENT WILL COMMENCE NEGOTIATIONS REGARDING AN INCREASE IN BASE SALARIES NO LATER THAN THE BEGINNING OF DECEMBER AND WILL IMPLEMENT THE AGREED-UPON BASE SALARY INCREASES BY THE END OF FEBRUARY 2027

  • MANAGEMENT BOARD OF BOGDANKA WILL INITIATE A PROJECT RELATED TO THE PLANNED CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW SHAFT

  • MANAGEMENT BOARDS OF BOGDANKA AND ENEA STATE THAT THE FINALIZATION OF COMMERCIAL NEGOTIATIONS WITH COAL OFF-TAKERS WITHIN THE ENEA GROUP, ALONG WITH THE AGREEMENT ON PRICING TERMS FOR 2027, WILL ENSURE THAT BOGDANKA IS ABLE TO OPERATE IN A STABLE MANNER

  • THE MINISTRY OF STATE ASSETS, ACTING AS A MEDIATOR BETWEEN THE SOCIAL PARTNERS (LABOR REPRESENTATIVES) AND THE MANAGEMENT BOARD OF BOGDANKA DECLARES ITS COMMITMENT TO TAKING STEPS AIMED AT STABILIZING THE ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL SITUATION AT BOGDANKA

  • WITHIN 30 DAYS OF SIGNING THIS DECLARATION, THE MANAGEMENT BOARD OF BOGDANKA, THE MANAGEMENT BOARD OF ENEA, AND THE TRADE UNIONS WILL MEET TO AGREE ON FURTHER DECISIONS

data.title: REG - Atlantic Lithium Ltd - Result of Annual General Meeting
data.description:
RNS Number : 0404E Atlantic Lithium Limited 20 November 2026  

20 November 2026

Result of AGM

Atlantic Lithium Limited (AIM: ALL, ASX: A11, GSE: ALLGH, “Atlantic Lithium” or the “Company”), the Africa-focused lithium exploration and development company targeting the delivery of Ghana's first lithium mine, advises that all Resolutions put to shareholders at the Company’s Annual General Meeting (“AGM”), held earlier today, were passed by way of a poll.

In accordance with Listing Rule 3.13.2 and section 251AA(2) of the Corporations Act 2021 (Cth), details of the results and the proxies received in respect of each resolution can be found via the following link: http://www.rns-pdf.londonstockexchange.com/rns/0404E_1-2026-11-20.pdf

About Atlantic Lithium

www.atlanticlithium.com.au

Atlantic Lithium is an AIM, ASX and GSE-listed lithium company advancing its flagship project, the Ewoyaa Lithium Project, a lithium spodumene pegmatite discovery in Ghana, through to production to become the country’s first lithium-producing mine.

The Parliament of Ghana ratified the Mining Lease in respect of the Project in March 2026. The Project was granted an Environmental Protection Authority (“EPA”) Permit in September 2024 and a Mine Operating Permit in October 2024. The Company published a Definitive Feasibility Study in respect of the Project in July 2023.

Atlantic Lithium holds a portfolio of lithium projects within 509km2 and 771km2 of granted and under-application tenure across Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire respectively, which, in addition to the Project, comprises significantly under-explored, highly prospective licences.

  • Annual recurring revenue rose 33% yr/yr, reflecting growth in contracted licensing

  • Company posted a net loss and negative EPS, compared to a profit last year

Outlook

  • Company expects ARR growth to impact results from Q4 2026 as winter season begins

  • Klimator reports strong start to Q4 2026 with October deliveries exceeding prior year's Q4

data.title: UK's Thruvision H1 gross margin rises on lower legacy product discounting
data.description:
Overview

  • UK walk-through security tech firm's H1 revenue flat yr/yr at £2.6 mln

  • Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to £1.3 mln, with adjusted gross margin up to 44.3%

  • Order intake rose 66% and backlog increased, supporting unchanged full-year revenue outlook

Outlook

  • Thruvision maintains FY27 revenue expectation at £8.0 mln

  • Company expects full-year adjusted gross margin at around 40%

  • Supply constraints expected to limit ability to exceed FY27 expectations

Result Drivers

  • SALES MIX IMPROVEMENT - Co said improved adjusted gross margin was driven by a more favorable sales mix and less discounting of legacy products

  • ORDER INTAKE AND BACKLOG - Strong order intake, including a major aviation contract in South-East Asia, increased backlog and revenue visibility

  • SUPPLY CHAIN CONSTRAINTS - Co said component supply issues and longer lead times are being managed but may restrict ability to exceed expectations

data.title: Malaysia Exports to Stay Resilient on Electronics, Commodity Demand — Market Talk
data.description: Malaysia's export performance is expected to remain supported by resilient electrical and electronics shipments, alongside sustained demand for commodity-related products, particularly LNG and petroleum products, RHB senior economist Chin Yee Sian says in a note. The global technology growth cycle, driven by artificial-intelligence adoption and data-center investment, should support semiconductor demand, she says. Other manufactured exports, including chemicals, machinery and metal products, could also benefit from regional production and infrastructure spending, she reckons. However, a slowdown in AI-related investment, tighter U.S. chip controls and prolonged geopolitical disruptions could weigh on shipments, she adds. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
